Class Group

java.lang.Object
threepl.exec.Body
threepl.exec.Group
All Implemented Interfaces:
TDEConstants, Constant
public class Group extends Body implements Constant, TDEConstants
This class is a 3PL class definition. The class identifier is 'Group' to avoid conflict and confusion with the Java keyword 'class' It extends class 'Body' which contains most of the fields needed.

      public Group(Token t, Body b, Scope filescope)
      Construct a group definition.
      Parameters:
      t - is the group identifier token which provides both the group identifier and the source file location of the definition
      b - is the enclosing group, named module, procedure or function
      filescope - is the file scope for the group
